recipes.title: Cod Fish Salad
steps: Soak the salt cod fish in cold water for 30 minutes to draw out excess sodium.
Drain the salt cod, place it into a pot with clean water, bring to a boil, and simmer for several minutes.
Transfer the boiled cod into cold water to cool slightly, drain, flake into bite-sized pieces, and give it a final light rinse.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over low heat, add the crushed garlic, chopped cabbage, diced bell peppers, sazón, and paprika, and sauté for a few minutes while stirring.
Gently fold in the flaked cod fish, diced tomatoes, oregano, parsley, and an extra splash of olive oil, cooking briefly until the vegetables are tender.
Serve warm over portions of steamed white rice.
recipes.notes: Equipment: Large saucepan for boiling fish, large skillet for sautéing. Requires 30 minutes passive soaking time before cooking. White rice is prepared separately according to package directions before plating.
